final_lessons: Starting baseline: prefer higher-capacity residual networks for univariate regression when learning rate is low.
Previous winner used heavy layer norm and no residual; layer normalization seems to matter more than depth.
Deeper (5-6) width-64 networks consistently win in this dataset regardless of residual.
High-capacity deep networks (depth 5+) tend to achieve lowest MSE on this dataset.
Deeper non-residual width-64 networks with layer norms tend to win here.
Depth-6 width-64 residual networks consistently achieve lowest MSE here.
Wide width-256 networks compete strongly with deep networks on this dataset.
Deep networks (depth 5+) with large width dominate; shallow narrow ones lose.
Depth-4 non-residual width-64 (c_3ae475) is a proven near-optimal architecture here.
Depth-6 width-64 residual network (c_c29b8a) is a proven strong performer here.
